standfirst: The cleanest taxon in this group: three overlapping ORFs, a ~1,830 aa replicase, a ~628 aa overlapping movement protein and a ~189 aa coat protein. 96.2% of features binned.

modules.Tymovirus: MP is bound before REP, because in tymoviruses the movement protein is defined by overlapping the replicase ORF -- any string naming both belongs to MP.

gaps: 25 references reach 94 of 102 genomes; 8 clusters holding 8 genomes are uncovered and are named in the coverage audit. The residual unbinned strings are positional labels (HP2, HP3) and bare hypothetical protein.
